mission.title: Pound the Pavement
mission.description: Trace the jamming device found at the scene of the theft.

phase.briefing: It is necessary that you speak with Kalt now, {player}. You will find her in her offices at the Kalt building in Kedemoth.

enter.say: Kalt should be on site here.

talk.say:
So, you must be {player}. I heard you might be stopping by. I have my ways, you know.
I do have some information for you regarding the incident. I would assume that by sharing this information, I'm cooperating with the Machines? I value being left alone. I'm sure you understand.
Where was I... ah, yes. I don't know the identity of the people involved, but I do know this: a device was found at the scene. Some sort of jamming device, quite advanced, actually. Only one person I know of could have made the device. Silver.

phase.briefing:
Silver. Silver is a very intriguing Exile... he has actually performed some research for us in the past. I have his contact information.
Speak with him and find out about this jamming device.

enter.say: I'm reading a lone signal in here... looks like Silver is on site.
What the-- I'm reading signals incoming!

done.say: Silver's got a lot of explaining to do...

talk.say:
Hmm, those programs didn't perform at all as expected. Perhaps their synchronization module...
What? Oh, come on, Meatbag, you can't expect to just waltz in here asking whatever you want without payment. You have aided me in my research. Consider yourself lucky; there are many other experiments I could subject you to.

The jamming device... the device. Oh yes. Something like a typical jammer, but much more comprehensive. Using that device, one could theoretically even carry out activities without the knowledge of the Machines. I was contracted by some ruffians from... now what gang was that? Ah, yes. The Demon Army. I can only assume they were the ones to use it, as I don't really care enough to find out.
One thing though... they actually supplied me with a piece of the device themselves. I don't know how the Demon Army would get their hands on something like that.

done.say: The Demon Army, up in Tabor... I think I know where we're headed.

phase.briefing:
The Demon Army... they are an insignificant speck of a gang. You shall pursue more extreme measures against them.
Destroy them, and keep destroying them, until you find something useful.

enter.say:
This new strategy of Gray's doesn't seem very focused. More of a shotgun approach, really, but... whatever.
There should be plenty of Demon Army members in here for you to occupy yourself with.

objective.text: Kill all of the Demon Army

done.say: That's the last hoodlum. Now check around and see if you can find anything to help our search.

objective.text: Get the document from the Demon Army Lieutenant

done.say: That document must be important. In fact, come to think of it, every document you find seems to be important somehow...

complete.say: All Demon Army members dead: check. One mysterious address found: check. Time to go where it points to.

phase.briefing: I do not require any further updates from you until you have achieved your goal, {player}.

enter.say: Gray seems kinda snippy, huh? Anyhow, check out this location. Hopefully we'll turn up something more concrete this time. Oh, and kill all the Demon Army you find here too, of course.

objective.text: Kill all of the Demon Army

done.say: There must be something around here... be sure to search all those bodies!

objective.text: Get the disk from the Demon Army Courier

done.say: That disk looks interesting. Better upload it when you get a chance.

objective.text: Upload the disk at a hardline

mission.finish: We are analyzing the data you uploaded. Contact me again after the process has been completed.
